rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YIFFANY, HAVE YOU COME ACROSS ANY TELEPORTALS YET?]
rows.current: Mauser: [伊吠妮，你遇到传送门了吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH, I'VE JUST ENCOUNTERED ONE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嗯，我刚遇到过一个。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HOW'S MY SHIP BEEN SINCE I LEFT IT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我走之后我的飞船怎么样了？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE'VE USED SATELLITE R18 TO SET IT ON FOLLOW MODE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我们用卫星 R18 把它设成了跟随模式，所以你应该能传送进你的飞船了，亲爱的。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO TELEPORT INTO IT, DEAR.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GREAT, I CAN'T WAIT TO FIND SOMETHING THAT'S A PROPER FU-]
rows.current: Yiffany: [太好了，我已经迫不及待想找到真正好用的——]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HOLD ON THERE PUP. YOUR SHIP MAY BE BARELY WORKING]
rows.current: Bossu: [先等等，小家伙。你的飞船虽然还能勉强运转，但只能贴地飞行。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT YOU MAY ONLY FLY NAP-OF-THE- EARTH.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE CAN'T RISK YOU GETTING REDOWNED... OR WORSE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [不能冒险让你再次被击落……甚至遭遇更糟的事。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AWWW MAAAAAN!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [啊啊——！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO GOING AFTER THOSE SCUM WITH GUNS BLAZING, GRRRL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不准开着枪冲去找那帮混蛋，丫头。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [THAT'S RIGHT! WE'RE RELYING SOLELY ON YOU NOW!]
rows.current: Mauser: [没错！现在我们只能指望你了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ALRIGHT ALRIGHT, I'LL TAKE THINGS SLOWLY...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好吧好吧，我会慢慢来的……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [GOOD GIRL. DON'T FORGET, WE'RE ALL HERE TO HELP YOU.]
rows.current: Bossu: [好姑娘。别忘了，我们都在这儿帮你。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND ON TOP OF THAT, THE HANGAR THAT THE OTHER AGENTS]
rows.current: Bossu: [而且除此之外，其他特工当作自动驾驶服务站使用的那个机库，似乎还在运行。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WERE USING AS AN AUTOPILOT SERVICE STATION]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SEEMS TO STILL BE RUNNING.]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YOU SHOULD STOP BY THERE AND SEE IF ANYONE'S AROUND!]
rows.current: Mauser: [你该去那边看看有没有人在！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SOUNDS LIKE A GOOD IDEA. ROGER THAT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [听起来不错。收到！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [THAT PLATFORM RIGHT THERE IS A TELEPORTAL, YIFFAI!]
rows.current: Mauser: [就在那边的平台是传送门，伊吠！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [ACTIVATE IT TO BE TAKEN DIRECTLY TO YOUR SHIP.]
rows.current: Mauser: [启动它就能直接把你送到你的飞船。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT... TO MY SHIP???]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么……到我的飞船？？？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S RIGHT BUDDY BOY, THANKS TO SATELLITE R18]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没错，老弟，多亏了卫星 R18，我们成功把它设成自动跟随你了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE WERE ABLE TO SET IT TO AUTOMATICALLY FOLLOW YOU]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO THAT MEANS I CAN GO AFTER THOSE BAST-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那我就能去找那帮混——]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [AWWW MAAAAAN! SERIOUSLY?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊啊——！真的假的？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AS OUR ONLY ACTIVE AGENT NOW, YOU CAN'T BE SO RISKY!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH PUP, PUT ON YOUR BIG BOY PANTS AND TAKE IT SLOWLY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就是啊，小狗崽，穿大人的裤子，就得稳着点来。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...OH WAIT YOU LOST THOSE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……哦，等等，你把裤子弄丢了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OKAY, OKAY! I'LL TRY AND BE A BIT MORE STRATEGIMICAL.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [好好好！我会试着更有点战策性的。]

rows.current: Yiffany: [我当然没事，别担心我，小家伙。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
